links.outcome: Composite decision-quality scores comparing five LLMs on the same 250 cases
links.effect: Composite scores differed among models (p < 0.001); ChatGPT highest (5.72 ± 0.21), outperforming Gemini, DeepSeek, LLaMA and Grok (all p < 0.001).
links.quote: Composite decision-quality scores (mean of five 6-point Likert domains; 1 = very poor, 6 = excellent) differed among models (p < 0.001), with ChatGPT achieving the highest overall performance (5.72 ± 0.21), outperforming Gemini (p < 0.001), DeepSeek (p < 0.001), LLaMA (p < 0.001), and Grok (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and benchmarks the performance, safety, and guideline adherence of five LLMs on 250 retrospective patient cases in otolaryngology, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
